subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
RECIPIENT_NAME 您好，
接着我上一封关于为 {Brand} 扩大购买的邮件，再补一点。最值得重提的是：我们只认确认成交的首单这一个收入事件，购买都经 MMP 服务器回传带订单号与金额确认，并按退货调整后结算。我们当时为唯品会和得物做的就是这套口径，每天能做到 8,000 笔购买这一量级。如果有用，我可以发一份按品类的购买明细。要不简单聊聊?
angle: warm bump, restate confirmed-purchase + return-adjusted settlement proof
illustrative_flags: 每天 8,000 笔购买 (8,000 purchases a day) - MobUpps-specific daily volume, illustrative capability '能做到', not an audited result
register_notes: Stage 1 zh China ecommerce UA: references prior email in first sentence; restates single proof (confirmed first-purchase event + MMP server postback + return-adjusted settlement) from parent; peers 唯品会/得物 reused from parent only; one illustrative figure (8,000 purchases/day) flagged; soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native Mandarin, no script-mixing beyond curated acronyms/proper nouns; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
